name: vs-control-bridge
description: Expose native VS Code browser, testing and editor tools to the VS Control Claude Code plugin.

commands.title: VS Control: Show Connection and Tools
VS Control: Pick Element for Claude

vsControl.enabled.description: Start the local Claude Code bridge in trusted workspaces.

vsControl.nativeToolGroups.description: Groups of native VS Code tools exposed to Claude. Requires the tools to be available in vscode.lm.tools.

vsControl.additionalToolNames.description: Exact additional vscode.lm tool IDs to expose. Inspect them with vscode_tools first. MCP tools are excluded to prevent recursive bridges.

vsControl.additionalCommands.description: Additional command IDs callable through vscode_command. These commands may perform arbitrary actions.

vsControl.toolTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for tool calls, including time spent waiting for native VS Code confirmations.
